task: Open `/home/user/Documents/cloud.ply` and `/home/user/Documents/plane.obj` in CloudCompare. Compute the distance from each point in `cloud.ply` to the surface of `plane.obj`, and store the resulting per-point distance values as a scalar field associated with the point cloud. Export the enriched point cloud as an ASCII PLY file at `/home/user/Documents/cloud_c2m.ply`. The output must preserve all 800 points and include an additional per-vertex scalar property containing the computed distances.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/cloud.ply and /home/user/Documents/plane.obj in CloudCompare. cloud.ply is an ASCII PLY with 800 points offset above the Z=0 plane; plane.obj is a triangulated planar square mesh on Z=0. Select cloud.ply as the compared entity and the plane.obj mesh as the reference, then run Tools > Distances > Cloud/Mesh dist to compute per-point cloud-to-mesh distances. Accept the default settings. This attaches a scalar field containing the per-point distances to cloud.ply. Export the resulting cloud (with the scalar field) as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/cloud_c2m.ply. The exported file must include an extra scalar (distance) property per vertex beyond x,y,z and the 800-point count must be preserved.

verification.description: Scalar field property present beyond x,y,z

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
